changelog:
Initial release of trpg-yaml-to-md-scenarios.

- Automatically generates human-readable Markdown scenario files from existing YAML TRPG scenario files.
- Converts structured YAML data into natural, immersive Chinese prose suitable for GMs and players.
- Covers script title, introductory descriptions, scene flow, key NPCs, encounters, map details, objectives/rewards, and GM notes as needed.
- Markdown files are saved alongside their source YAML files, with the same filename and a .md extension.
- Ensures all outputs are in clean, print-friendly Traditional Chinese Markdown, without altering original YAML files.
summary: Use this skill when generating human-readable Markdown scenarios from existing YAML scenario files. Triggers on: generate MD from YAML scenarios, YAML to MD...
